statement:
a) Find a polynomial with integer coefficients of smallest degree having \(\sqrt{2}+\sqrt[3]{3}\) as a root.
b) Solve \(1 + \sqrt{1+x^2}\left(\sqrt{(1+x)^3} - \sqrt{(1-x)^3}\right) = 2\sqrt{1-x^2}\).

The sequence \((u_n)\) is defined by \(u_1=1\), \(u_2=2\) and \(u_{n+1}=3u_n-u_{n-1}\) for \(n \geq 2\). Set \(v_n = \displaystyle\sum_{k=1}^{n}\text{arccot}\, u_k\). Compute \(\lim_{n\to\infty} v_n\).

A square \(ABCD\) of side \(2a\) lies on plane \(\Pi\). Point \(S\) is on the ray \(Ax\) perpendicular to \(\Pi\) with \(AS=2a\). Variable points \(M \in BC\) and \(N \in CD\).
a) i. Find \(M, N\) with \(BM+DN \geq \frac{3}{2}\) such that planes \(SAM\) and \(SMN\) are perpendicular and \(BM \cdot DN\) is minimum. ii. Find \(M, N\) with \(\angle MAN=45^\circ\) such that the volume of \(SAMN\) is extremal.
b) Let \(Q\) satisfy \(\angle AQB = \angle AQD = 90^\circ\). Line \(DQ\) meets the plane \(\pi\) through \(AB\) perpendicular to \(\Pi\) at \(Q'\). i. Find the locus of \(Q'\). ii. Let \(K\) be the locus of \(Q\) and \(CQ\) meet \(K\) again at \(R\). Let \(DR\) meet \(\Pi\) at \(R'\). Prove that \(\sin^2\angle Q'DB + \sin^2\angle R'DB\) is independent of \(Q\).

a) Let \(x, y\) be integers, not both zero. Find the minimum of \(|5x^2+11xy-5y^2|\).
b) Find all positive reals \(t\) such that \(\dfrac{9t}{10} = \dfrac{\lfloor t \rfloor}{t - \lfloor t \rfloor}\).
Given reals \(a, b\) with \(a \neq 0\), find all polynomials \(P(x)\) satisfying \(xP(x-a) = (x-b)P(x)\).

Consider a trihedral angle \(Sxyz\) with \(\angle xSz=\alpha\), \(\angle xSy=\beta\), \(\angle ySz=\gamma\). Let \(A, B, C\) be the dihedral angles at edges \(y, z, x\) respectively.
a) Prove that \(\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{\sin A} = \dfrac{\sin\beta}{\sin B} = \dfrac{\sin\gamma}{\sin C}\).
b) Show that \(\alpha+\beta=180^\circ\) iff \(\angle A+\angle B=180^\circ\).
c) Assume \(\alpha=\beta=\gamma=90^\circ\). Let \(O \in Sz\) be fixed with \(SO=a\) and \(M, N\) variable on \(x, y\). Prove \(\angle SOM+\angle SON+\angle MON\) is constant and find the locus of the incenter of \(OSMN\).
